lead_html: Magic Voyage is a small minor scale over an F ding. It has no 4th and no 6th, so start with the i and v cards: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: F Magic Voyage has eight notes: the F ding, then Ab C Eb F G Ab C around the top. Only F, Ab, C, Eb and G are used. That is a minor pentatonic shape with a major 2nd (G) added. G and Ab sit a half step apart, which gives the scale its bite. We could not source a maker or a date for this layout from a public page we could link, so this page does not give one.
og_description: F Magic Voyage 8 handpan chords: the chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
